## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.
For behavior changes, describe the regression coverage you added.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I kept the change focused and read the [contribution guide](https://github.com/Zemdomu/ZemDomu-action/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I removed secrets, private source, customer data, and identifying paths from examples and logs.
- [ ] I added a grouped `Unreleased` changelog entry if the change affects users.
